Costs include two nurses at $95,000 each ($190,000 total) plus a $35,000 placement fee, summing to $225,000 in Year-1 expenses. Subtracting total costs ($225,000) from total savings ($240,000) yields a net Year-1 savings of $15,000. This figure is significantly below the user's explicit constraint of >= $100,000 net savings. Therefore, the proposal fails the financial viability test defined by the user.
risks_or_flaws: Net Year-1 savings of $15,000 is below the required $100,000 threshold
